mechanism: Rasagiline is an irreversible MAO-B inhibitor that can potentiate the sympathomimetic effects of brimonidine (an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist), increasing risk of hypertension and CNS stimulation.
action: Monitor blood pressure and CNS symptoms closely; use brimonidine ophthalmic cautiously in patients on rasagiline, ensuring appropriate dosing and patient education on warning signs of hypertensive crisis.
